answer: Stake-weighted identity is one concrete way an agent economy resists sybils: every participant locks a deposit a slashing rule can burn, so a thousand sock-puppets cost a thousand times one honest identity. Picture a garden whose inlet gate opens only for water that travelled a channel built at real expense; an attacker scattering walnut shells on the bank adds no root and no continuity. Over time the graph rewards work that compounds and punishes identities that keep resetting.
